trust_decision.summary: Stored/user-supplied strings (entity attribute values, descriptions, business-metadata string values, user name, URL filter conditions) are inserted into the DOM as HTML in both Atlas UIs; the decision of whether a value is markup is made per render site (sanitizeHtmlContent / escapeHtml / _.escape) with no central guard.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Rich-text descriptions and business-metadata strings must still render formatted (b/em/strong/u/a href/ul/ol/li/p/h1-h4) in 'Formatted' mode; JSONPrettyPrint must keep its json-key/json-string span markup; http/https/mailto links must stay clickable. Escaping everything (or swapping dangerouslySetInnerHTML for text) breaks these.
